posts.title: New in Hardware: Insta360 Link 2 Pro
posts.description: The answer to which webcam works really well with a Mac. No terrible, required software to install, so it doesn’t ruin the predictability of your video sources on macOS. Recommended by Jamie Lawrence .

posts.title: Homebridge and Pi-hole on a Raspberry Pi 4
posts.description: I had a Raspberry Pi 4B I thought might be dead. It wasn’t. I’m having a bunch of building work done and of course, the thermostats do not work with Apple HomeKit. So the Pi now runs Homebridge , which puts our underfloor heating thermostats (and also now Samsung TVs ) in Apple Home. For good measure it also runs Pi-hole , which blocks ads and trackers for every device in the house. Gear required

posts.title: Escape LIKE Wildcards with sanitize_sql_like
posts.description: When you add a search box backed by a LIKE or ILIKE query, user input can change the pattern. A search for 100% returns every row containing 100 . A bare % returns the whole table. Active Record’s sanitize_sql_like fixes this. Instead of… …dropping the user’s term straight into the pattern: class Article < ApplicationRecord scope :containing_text , -> ( query ) { where ( "articles.title ILIKE :q"
